title: DATESYTD over a calendar, with only an untagged column filtered, is every date of the year
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "first", MINX ( DATESYTD ( Gregorian ), 'Date'[Date] ), "last", MAXX ( DATESYTD ( Gregorian ), 'Date'[Date] ), "days", COUNTROWS ( DATESYTD ( Gregorian ) ) ), 'Date'[DateKey] >= 20080801, 'Date'[DateKey] <= 20080813 )

source.quote: For example, with a filter on the DateKey column from August 1 to August 13, 2008, DATESYTD ( Gregorian ) returns January 1 to December 31, 2008
source.supports: the whole year of the last visible date

derivation: The year of 2008-08-13 is 2008; Date has its days from July 27 to September 6 only: 42 days.
